answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 37662 Country: India Title: After Quran khawani people used to keep sweets or any dish in front and light agarbatti then do fatiha which afterwards is distributed as shirini Question: After Quran khawani people used to keep sweets or any dish in front and light agarbatti then do fatiha which afterwards is distributed as shirini. Please give authentication in the light of Islamic belief quoting the holy Quran. Answer ID: 37662 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 624/624/M=1433) It is not proved from Shariah to do niyaz and fatiha by keeping the sweet etc in front. And the prevalent Quran khawani is also not free from being makrooh. One should do isal-e-sawab according to the established and sunnah method avoiding un-Islamic customs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
